column1: # Project: Fightcamp (working title)  ## What it is A single-player MMA gym manager sim with realistic 3D fight animation and a stress-based training loop.  Management layer: MMA Promoter (weight classes, fight cards, gym reputation, rankings, contracts, rivalries, PPV splits) Training loop: Darkest Dungeon (stress, afflictions, quirks, perma-death, real-time 3D gym, random events) Fight animation: Tekken 8 (physics-driven 3D, ragdoll, facial damage, weight transfer, striking + grappling transitions)  NOT Football Manager. No league tables, no transfer windows, no tactical formations. This is MMA. NOT a spreadsheet. Training is WATCHED in 3D, never a menu click.  ## Engine & Stack - Engine: Unreal Engine 5 (C++ + Blueprint) - Platform: PC (Steam) - Target: 60fps, 1080p, mid-range GPU - No multiplayer. Single-player only. - All content data-driven (JSON / DataTables, not hardcoded)  ## Core Systems (in build order) 1. Fighter data model (stats, stress, quirks, career) 2. Stress & affliction system (Darkest Dungeon mechanics) 3. Training gym scene (real-time 3D, activities, events) 4. Cage fight scene (3D animated, damage model, cameras) 5. Management layer (gym, contracts, finances, fight cards, rankings) 6. UI (gym view, fight broadcast, roster, office) 7. Audio (commentary, crowd, SFX, music)  ## Design Rules - Training is WATCHED in 3D, never a menu click - Stress is visible on the fighter (animation speed, breathing,   movement quality, facial expression) - Perma-death: career-ending injuries are permanent - Quirks are permanent and unique per fighter - Fights use physics-driven 3D animation (not cutscenes) - No open world. Bounded spaces only (gym, cage, office) - Weight classes: flyweight, bantamweight, featherweight,   lightweight, welterweight, middleweight, light heavyweight,   heavyweight. Fighters cannot cross weight classes. - Fight cards: main event, co-main, 4–6 undercard bouts - Contract model: purse, PPV split %, % of gate - Rankings: 15 per weight class, title shot at #1 - Rivalries: generated from past fights, taunts, gym politics  ## Constraints - Max 20 fighters in a gym - 5–8 fights per season (each season = 12 weeks) - 3 difficulty levels (Rookie, Pro, Legend) - No real-time multiplayer - 3D style: stylized-realistic (not photoreal, not cartoon) - All fighter meshes: UE5 mannequin as placeholder until   custom assets are generated via fal.ai  ## Code Conventions - C++ for core systems (combat, stress, data), Blueprint for   UI, scene logic, and camera - All game data in DataTables (not hardcoded) - Git: conventional commits, one system per branch - Every UFUNCTION that mutates state must have a corresponding   unit test - CHANGELOG.md updated after every completed system  ## universal-modder Integration - Installed: /plugin marketplace add rehan-remade/universal-modder - Skills used: game-recon, reverse-engineering, fal-assets,   asset-pipeline, mashup-mods, game-automation, showcase-video,   mod-any-game (Unreal playbook) - FAL_KEY is set in environment - Asset pipeline: fal.ai → asset-pipeline → UE5-ready format - Testing: um win drive for automated playtesting - Launch: um video compile for showcase, um publish check

column6: You are the Builder agent. Read CLAUDE.md.  Task: Create the Fighter data model in C++.  Requirements: - USTRUCT FighterStats: striking (0-100), grappling (0-100),   cardio (0-100), chin (0-100), aggression (0-100) - USTRUCT FighterState: stress (0-200 float, ticks in real-time),   currentAffliction (enum: none, paranoid, masochistic, hopeless,   selfish, zealous, tenacious, heroic), quirks (array of string),   careerStatus (enum: active, injured, retired),   weightClass (enum: flyweight through heavyweight) - UFUNCTION: ApplyStress(float amount) — caps at 200,   triggers affliction check at 100 - UFUNCTION: ApplyQuirk(string quirkId) — permanent, modifies stats   per quirk definition in data/quirks.json - UFUNCTION: ApplyInjury(string injuryId) — sets careerStatus,   applies stat penalties - Save/load via JSON (one file per fighter in data/fighters/)  Output:   Source/Fighter/FighterData.h   Source/Fighter/FighterData.cpp   schemas/fighter.json   data/fighters/ (empty, Content agent fills later)  Do NOT include UI, 3D, or any scene. Data model only. Must compile.
column7: You are the Builder agent. Read CLAUDE.md and plans/stress-system.md.  Task: Implement the stress accumulation and affliction system.  Requirements: - Stress ticks up in real-time during training activities:   - Bag work: +2.0/s   - Sparring: +4.0/s   - Conditioning: +1.0/s   - Rest: -5.0/s   - Ice bath: -10.0/s (one-time, 30s duration) - At stress >= 100: trigger random affliction from pool   (weighted: paranoid 25%, masochistic 20%, hopeless 20%,   selfish 15%, zealous 10%, tenacious 7%, heroic 3%) - Affliction effects (applied while active, removed when stress < 50):   - paranoid: refuses to spar with specific partners (random 2)   - masochistic: takes +15% damage in fights, gains +10 striking   - hopeless: all stats decay 5% per week until stress < 50   - selfish: won't share gym resources (training slots reduced)   - zealous: +10 aggression, -5 cardio, takes more risks in fights   - tenacious: -10% stress gain, +5 chin   - heroic: +10 all stats for 1 week, then -5 all stats - At stress >= 180: BREAKDOWN event   - 50%: career-ending injury (perma-death, fighter retired)   - 30%: serious injury (out 4–8 weeks, stat penalty)   - 20%: mental breakdown (all stats -20% for 2 weeks) - At stress drops below 20 after having been > 100:   BREAKTHROUGH chance (30%): new permanent quirk from pool - Stress is VISIBLE: fighter animation speed scales inversely   with stress (at 180 stress, animation plays at 70% speed)  Output:   Source/Stress/StressSystem.h   Source/Stress/StressSystem.cpp   data/afflictions.json (7 afflictions with effects)   data/breakdowns.json (breakdown event definitions)   data/quirks.json (20 quirks with stat modifiers)  Must compile. Unit tests for: stress capping, affliction trigger, breakdown at 180, breakthrough at 20.
column8: You are the Builder agent. Read CLAUDE.md and plans/gym-scene.md.  Task: Create the training gym scene and real-time training loop.  Requirements: - Gym scene (UE5 level):   - Bag corner (3 heavy bags, 1 speed bag)   - Sparring area (2x2m mat, 2 fighters)   - Weight room (dumbbells, barbell rack, treadmill)   - Recovery room (ice bath, physio table, massage table)   - Office (desk, whiteboard, phone — for management layer later) - 4 training activities, each a 3D animation loop on the fighter:   - Bag work: striking +5/week, stress +2.0/s   - Sparring: striking +3/week, grappling +3/week, stress +4.0/s   - Conditioning: cardio +5/week, stress +1.0/s   - Rest: all stats recover 2/week, stress -5.0/s - Player assigns each fighter to ONE activity per game day - Time: 1 real minute = 1 game day (accelerated) - 1 week = 7 game days. At end of week:   - Show stat changes   - Show stress changes   - Trigger any new quirks, injuries, afflictions   - Random event check (1 per day, 20% chance) - Random events (data/training_events.json, 20 events):   - "Sparring partner goes too hard" → +10 stress, -5 HP   - "Rival taunts in the gym" → +15 stress, +5 aggression   - "Coach pushes extra round" → +20 stress, +10 cardio   - "Fighter gets sick" → -10 all stats for 3 days   - "Sponsor visits, fighter signs autographs" → +5 stress,     +10 gym reputation   - "Fighter watches old fight footage" → -10 stress,     +5 striking   - (14 more — Content agent generates) - UI: top bar shows each fighter's name, stress bar (colored:   green < 50, yellow 50-100, red > 100), current activity icon - Player can click a fighter to see: stats, quirks, affliction,   injury status, backstory  Output:   Content/GymScene/GymScene.umap   Source/Gym/TrainingController.h   Source/Gym/TrainingController.cpp   data/training_events.json (20 events)   data/activities.json (4 activities with stat/stress values)   Blueprints: BP_GymUI, BP_FighterToken (draggable to activity slots)  Must compile. `um win drive` test: launch game, verify gym scene loads, verify a fighter can be assigned to bag work, verify stress bar increases.
column9: You are the Builder agent. Read CLAUDE.md and plans/fight-scene.md.  Task: Create the cage fight scene with 3D animated fights.  Requirements: - Octagon cage: circular, 8 sides, 3m radius, 1.5m wall height,   canvas floor with sponsor logos (placeholder: white) - 2 fighter skeletal meshes: UE5 mannequin (placeholder)   - Each fighter's mesh uses their actual stat values to drive     animation intensity (high striking = faster punches,     low cardio = slower movement in round 3) - Camera system (3 angles, smooth transitions):   - BROADCAST_WIDE: shows full cage, both fighters, 10s hold   - OVER_SHOULDER: behind fighter A, looking at fighter B, 5s hold   - CLOSE_UP: on the active fighter's face, 3s hold   - Auto-cut: switch angle on every significant hit (damage > 10) - Fight state machine:   INTRO (walkout, 10s) → ROUND 1 (5 min) → BREAK (1 min) →   ROUND 2 (5 min) → BREAK (1 min) → ROUND 3 (5 min) →   FINISH (KO/TKO/SUBMISSION/DECISION) - Damage model:   - Each hit: damage = attacker_striking × 0.5 - defender_chin × 0.3   - Minimum damage: 1   - HP: 100 per fighter   - HP <= 0: KO (ragdoll animation, 3s, then FINISH)   - HP <= 30: fighter is "wobbling" (animation speed -30%,     movement impaired)   - Grapple: if defender grappling > attacker striking,     chance of submission (10% per 5s of grapple, scales with     defender grappling stat)   - Decision: if all 3 rounds complete, winner = higher total     damage dealt (simplified judge system) - Affliction effects IN FIGHT:   - masochistic: takes +15% damage, but striking +10   - zealous: aggression +10 (attacks more often, but misses more)   - paranoid: won't grapple (striking only)   - hopeless: all damage dealt -20% - Broadcast UI (bottom of screen during fight):   - Fighter names, weight class, record   - Round number, timer   - Hidden damage bars (only visible in "broadcast" mode,     not in "manager" mode) - Post-fight:   - Winner announced (3D text + audio)   - Stats updated (stress +30 for loser, +10 for winner)   - If KO: loser gets injury (50% serious, 50% minor)   - Fight result feeds back into management layer (rankings,     rivalries, contract bonuses)  Output:   Content/FightScene/FightScene.umap   Source/Fight/FightController.h   Source/Fight/FightController.cpp   Source/Fight/FightState.h   Source/Fight/DamageModel.h   Source/Fight/CameraRig.h   data/fight_rules.json (damage formulas, round times, KO conditions)   Blueprints: BP_FightUI, BP_CageCamera, BP_FightDirector  Must compile. `um win drive` test: launch fight scene, verify 2 mannequins in cage, verify camera cuts on hit, verify KO triggers ragdoll, verify fight ends after 3 rounds if no KO.
column10: You are the Builder agent. Read CLAUDE.md and plans/management.md.  Task: Create the gym management layer (MMA Promoter systems).  Requirements: - Gym:   - Name (player-set), location, reputation (0-100)   - Max 20 fighters   - Training slots: 4 (only 4 fighters can train simultaneously,     others must wait — creates resource management pressure)   - Income: monthly base (from sponsor) + % of fight gate   - Expenses: fighter salaries (based on rank), gym rent,     equipment, medical - Fighters:   - Scout: browse a pool of 50 generated fighters (Content agent)     per weight class. Each has: stats, quirks, backstory,     asking salary, potential (hidden, 1-5)   - Contract: purse (per fight), PPV split % (0-50%),     % of gate (0-30%), duration (1-5 fights)   - Salary: weekly, based on rank and weight class   - Release: can release a fighter (they join a rival gym,     rivalry +10) - Fight cards:   - Build a card: select 5–8 bouts from your roster   - Order: main event (highest stakes), co-main, undercard   - Opponents: auto-generated from other gyms (rival gyms     have their own rosters, managed by simple AI)   - Revenue: gate (based on reputation + main event quality)     + PPV (based on PPV split + fighter popularity)   - Schedule: 1 fight card per 4 weeks - Rankings:   - 15 per weight class   - Update after each fight card   - #1 gets title shot at next card   - Title: champion holds belt for 3 cards (or until defeated) - Rivalries:   - Generated from: past fights (loser hates winner),     gym politics, taunts (random event), weight class proximity   - Rivalry level: 0-100. At 80+: "feud" (PPV bonus,     special intro animation, crowd noise +50%) - Office scene (UE5):   - Desk with phone (call fighters, negotiate)   - Whiteboard (fight card layout, drag-and-drop)   - TV screen (shows fight replay after each card)   - Filing cabinet (fighter contracts, medical records)  Output:   Source/Management/GymManager.h   Source/Management/GymManager.cpp   Source/Management/FightCardBuilder.h   Source/Management/FightCardBuilder.cpp   Source/Management/RankingSystem.h   Source/Management/RankingSystem.cpp   Source/Management/RivalrySystem.h   Source/Management/RivalrySystem.cpp   data/gym_config.json (salaries, rent, sponsor rates)   data/rival_gyms.json (5 rival gyms with AI rosters)   Content/Office/Office.umap   Blueprints: BP_OfficeUI, BP_FightCardBoard, BP_ScoutScreen  Must compile. `um win drive` test: launch office, verify scout screen shows 50 fighters, verify a fight card can be built with 5 bouts, verify revenue is calculated.
